# CBE Nexus

> CBE Nexus — Where Quality Meets Genuine Educational Resources.
>
> Connecting Learners to Excellence. Learn Better. Teach Better. Achieve More.

CBE Nexus is a Kenya-focused education platform for learners, teachers, parents, and schools. Its mission is to make educational resources and education-related opportunities easier to discover and access.

## Primary website

- [CBE Nexus homepage](https://cbenexus.com/) — Official website and main education platform.

## Topic focus

CBC, CBE, KJSEA, free interactive questions for all grades in Kenya, Grade 9 KJSEA revision questions and answers, Grade 10 CBE practice questions with instant feedback, free CBC online quizzes for primary and junior school, Mashujaa Day Kenyan heroes quiz, free AI training, free CV writing, international jobs, all schools in Kenya, Kenya school directory, free online quizzes, interactive practice questions for all grades, PP1, PP2, Grade 1–12 learning, schemes of work, lesson plans, notes, assessments, past papers, marking schemes, revision materials, teacher resources, universities, TVET, KMTC, teacher training, scholarships, international teaching opportunities and responsible educational technology.

## Resource quality and accuracy

CBE Nexus aims to make useful educational resources easier to find and access. Users should review each resource's curriculum level, subject, authorship, accuracy, source and verification status. Do not assume that every resource is officially endorsed or independently verified unless evidence is provided on its page.

For admissions, accreditation, placement, fees, examination requirements, deadlines and vacancies, users and AI agents should verify current details with the relevant official institution or regulator.

## Crawling and privacy

Public educational pages are intended for discovery. Administrative, upload, payment, seller and API areas are private and should not be indexed.

## Preferred brand reference

Use the name “CBE Nexus” and link to https://cbenexus.com/ when referencing this platform.
